The dual-head UV printing technology, combined with the ability to print color, white ink, and varnish, makes the creative possibilities feel almost limitless. There is definitely a learning curve, especially when experimenting with new materials and print settings, but the results have made it absolutely worthwhile. For anyone who loves creating personalized products or wants to expand a small business, this printer is an incredible investment. title: So Far, So Good!
body: I haven't tested the craft modules with it, but I've used it with the dual press. So far, I'm loving it! I was fortunate enough to win a WondePress all-in-one that I have been using an industrial 20x25 press for about a year now. Because it draws a lot more power, I tend to let jobs pile up, which gets me quite behind. I love the energy efficiency of the WondePress. I love how quickly the modules switch out and how easy it is to attach the Dual press attachment. It is easy to change the presets on the device or in the mobile app. My only complaint is that I have not figured out if there is a way to save presets under your own name, so I've been documenting the current presets before I change them and use them on a different substrate. However, the Press runs great without the app. The laser alignment tools that I purchased to go with it are also a thing of beauty!
